title: oveRTOS Application Descriptor
description: Describes build sources and configuration for an oveRTOS application.

description.description: Human-readable description shown in Kconfig menu.

config_name.description: Kconfig symbol name for the app. Defaults to directory name if omitted.

c_sources.description: Additional C/C++ source files compiled alongside non-C apps (e.g. model data for Rust/Zig).

sources.description: Source file paths relative to the app directory (c/cpp only).

includes.description: Include directory paths relative to the app directory.

crate_dir.description: Path to Cargo.toml directory, relative to app dir. Default: '.'

src_dir.description: Path to Zig sources, relative to app dir. Default: 'src'

kconfig.description: Raw Kconfig content for app-specific configuration options.

platform_sources.description: RTOS-specific source overrides. Keys are RTOS names (posix, freertos, nuttx, zephyr) or 'default'. Values are arrays of source paths.

board_sources.description: Board-specific source overrides (takes priority over platform_sources). Keys are board names. Values are arrays of source paths.

defconfig.description: Kconfig lines for modules this app requires, merged during fragment-based configuration.
